lines.content: TENANCY AGREEMENT
Particulars
Agreement No: HP-TA-2026-974
Landlord: Haw Par Properties (Singapore) Pte Ltd
Tenant: Meridian Wellness Pte Ltd
Premises: #05-01, Haw Par Centre, 180 Clemenceau Avenue, Singapore
Lettable Area: 7564 sq ft
Commencement Date: 05 Feb 2026
Expiry Date: 04 Feb 2027
Term: 12 months
Monthly Rent: SGD 29,726.52
Security Deposit: SGD 178,359.12
Option to Renew: No
Permitted Use: General office
1. Rent and Payment
The Tenant shall pay the Rent monthly in advance without deduction or set-off on the first day of each
calendar month.
1.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
1.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
2. Security Deposit
The Deposit shall be held by the Landlord free of interest as security for the due performance of the Tenant
obligations.
2.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
2.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
3. Use of Premises
The Tenant shall not use the Premises otherwise than for the Permitted Use without the prior written consent
of the Landlord.
3.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
3.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
4. Repair and Maintenance
The Tenant shall keep the interior of the Premises in good and tenantable repair, fair wear and tear
excepted.
4.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
4.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
5. Insurance
The Tenant shall maintain public liability insurance of not less than SGD 2,000,000 for any one occurrence.
Page 1 of 30
5.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
5.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
6. Alterations
No structural alteration shall be carried out without the prior written approval of the Landlord and the
relevant authorities.
6.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
6.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
7. Assignment and Subletting
The Tenant shall not assign, sublet, or part with possession of the Premises or any part thereof.
7.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
7.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
8. Reinstatement
Upon expiry the Tenant shall reinstate the Premises to its original bare condition at the Tenant own cost.
8.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
8.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
9. Default and Re-entry
If the Rent remains unpaid for fourteen days the Landlord may re-enter the Premises and this tenancy shall
absolutely determine.
9.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
9.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
10. Force Majeure
Neither party shall be liable for failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control.
10.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
10.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
11. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Singapore.
11.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
11.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
12. Dispute Resolution
Any dispute shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration administered by the SIAC.

12.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
12.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.

SIGNED by the duly authorised representative of the Landlord in the presence of the witness named below.

TENANCY AGREEMENT
Particulars
Agreement No: HP-TA-2026-974
Landlord: Haw Par Properties (Singapore) Pte Ltd
Tenant: Meridian Wellness Pte Ltd
Premises: #05-01, Haw Par Centre, 180 Clemenceau Avenue, Singapore
Lettable Area: 7564 sq ft
Commencement Date: 05 Feb 2026
Expiry Date: 04 Feb 2027
Term: 12 months
Monthly Rent: SGD 29,726.52
Security Deposit: SGD 178,359.12
Option to Renew: No
Permitted Use: General office
1. Rent and Payment
The Tenant shall pay the Rent monthly in advance without deduction or set-off on the first day of each
calendar month.
1.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
1.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
2. Security Deposit
The Deposit shall be held by the Landlord free of interest as security for the due performance of the Tenant
obligations.
2.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
2.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
3. Use of Premises
The Tenant shall not use the Premises otherwise than for the Permitted Use without the prior written consent
of the Landlord.
3.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
3.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
4. Repair and Maintenance
The Tenant shall keep the interior of the Premises in good and tenantable repair, fair wear and tear
excepted.
4.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
4.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
5. Insurance
The Tenant shall maintain public liability insurance of not less than SGD 2,000,000 for any one occurrence.
Page 1 of 30
5.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
5.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
6. Alterations
No structural alteration shall be carried out without the prior written approval of the Landlord and the
relevant authorities.
6.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
6.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
7. Assignment and Subletting
The Tenant shall not assign, sublet, or part with possession of the Premises or any part thereof.
7.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
7.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
8. Reinstatement
Upon expiry the Tenant shall reinstate the Premises to its original bare condition at the Tenant own cost.
8.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
8.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
9. Default and Re-entry
If the Rent remains unpaid for fourteen days the Landlord may re-enter the Premises and this tenancy shall
absolutely determine.
9.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
9.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
10. Force Majeure
Neither party shall be liable for failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control.
10.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
10.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
11. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Singapore.
11.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
11.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
12. Dispute Resolution
Any dispute shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration administered by the SIAC.
Page 2 of 30
12.1 The parties acknowledge that time shall be of the essence in respect of this clause and all obligations
arising under it.
12.2 Any waiver by the Landlord of a breach of this clause shall not operate as a waiver of any subsequent
breach.
Execution
SIGNED by the duly authorised representative of the Landlord in the presence of the witness named below.
